function: no_learning: OTFS-MIMO ISAC receiver is iterative variational inference (GAMP, mean field, EM with gradient descent); its 'federated learning' only distributes gradient descent for UE position and velocity (pp. 1, 9, 10).
notes: Excluded as no_learning. p. 1: 'belief propagation, mean field, and expectation maximization algorithms for data detection, channel coefficient estimation, and kinematic parameter sensing are derived'; detection is GAMP (p. 8, Algorithm 1), sensing is EM with gradient descent (p. 9: 'we can learn parameters p by exploiting gradient descent algorithms'). The federated part (p. 10: 'FedGD-ISAC ... is essentially a distributed version of gradient descent algorithm'; 'the kinematic parameter p representing a global model') averages local gradients or local estimates of UE position and velocity over backhaul links (pp. 3, 10). No neural network or other model is trained on a dataset; simulations (pp. 11-12) compare with JCEDD-NLS and perfect-knowledge benchmarks only. If the federated scheme were counted as learning, its function would be localization with digital aggregation, excluded under function; no_learning applies first in the order of Step 1.
